title: Read a typed value
summary: The val method reads the current value of a form control.
introduction: The val method reads the current value of a form control. Your task: Type another name before clicking.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for read a typed value

blocks.text: The val method reads the current value of a form control. This is different from reading the text inside an ordinary paragraph.
Use a local HTML page that loads jQuery 3.7 before these scripts. Examples need that library; the plain playground does not include it. Put the script after the example markup.
Read the code step by step

items: A label's `for` value names the input id. That connection lets the label describe and focus the intended field.
`val()` reads a form control's current value. It is different from reading text inside a paragraph.

blocks.text: Clicking the button logs whatever name is currently in the input.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use val for inputs. text does not read the typed value.
